items.claim: Rra Alivera is the better striker in the matchup against Juliana Miller.
items.quote: I do think she's the better striker here.

items.claim: Juliana Miller does not have any defense on the feet.
items.quote: Juliana Miller is very, very hitable. She does not have any defense on the feet whatsoever.

items.claim: Rra Alivera has been submitted in the past and taken down and controlled.
items.quote: We've seen her submitted in the past. We've seen her get taken down and controlled.

items.claim: Juliana Miller is good on the ground.
items.quote: she is good on the ground for as much as we want to say about Julianiana Miller.

items.claim: Juliana Miller has a good gas tank and will not give up.
items.quote: She's got a good gas tank. I feel like the striking gap is closer than what the grappling gap is
